note: Rewritten from the species description of Chhotani (1997), the original in English, the content taken from Akhtar (1974); alates were recorded as unknown and only the soldier is described, with workers also unrecorded; synonymy, bibliographic citations, a cercus fragment (garbled by OCR) and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule, antennae and labrum yellow with a brownish tinge; mandibles dark brown; thorax and abdomen pale yellow; pilosity sparse over the whole body. Head capsule subquadrate, widest anteriorly, slightly longer than wide (length to mandibular base 1.13 mm, maximum width 1.05 mm). Frontal projection rounded, its apex raised and displaced posteriorly, the anterior margin convex, reaching the mandibular base. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 about as long as segment 3, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of the labrum weakly and broadly concave. Mandibles long, slender and rod-like, the apices incurved, much longer than the head (left mandible 1.42 mm long; ratio of left mandible length to head length 1.256). Postmentum club-shaped (length 0.40 mm, maximum width 0.30 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.18 mm, width 0.49 mm), without emargination on either the anterior or the posterior margin.
